recommended_queries.title: Canonical customers
recommended_queries.command: cove query customers.cove 'table(customers).select(customer_id, full_name, region, tier, score, status, plan, mrr).take(10)'

recommended_queries.title: High value customers
recommended_queries.command: cove query --engine compare --perf-report customers.cove 'table(customers).where(score >= 80).select(customer_id, tier, score, status, mrr).take(10)'

recommended_queries.title: Customer events through an external JSONL table
recommended_queries.command: cove query customers.cove --external-table events=events.jsonl 'table(customers) as c.join(table(events) as e, on: c.customer_id == e.customer_id).select(customer_id: c.customer_id, tier: c.tier, event_kind: e.event_kind, event_score: e.score).take(10)'
